findings.detail: PIK-only debt coupons are present in the SOI but were not populated into interest_rate when no cash leg is printed.

rationale: X02 flags private credit rows with blank interest_rate and blank basis_spread. The raw SOI has private credit debt rows whose Interest cells state usable PIK-only rates, such as 15.0% PIK, 10.0% PIK, 12.0% PIK, and 8.0% PIK. Those stated coupons should populate the rate field for income-return computation; leaving interest_rate blank is an extraction gap, not a false alarm.
